from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
BASE = ROOT / "work/ceres-v3/05"
FREEZE = BASE / "candidate-v4/baseline.json"
MANIFEST = json.loads(FREEZE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
EXPECTED_ZIP = "496e3417b4176ed3e4fcf35fda963037e193f6c357c9921c04bc47fde07b55f6"
PYTHON = ROOT / "backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"
ANALYZER = BASE / "analyze-evidence.py"
EVIDENCE = BASE / "evidence/20261006T063034368-f2b8c785af8745e7b39535c735aa930f"
RAW_ROUTES = EVIDENCE / "routing"
RAW_ROLES = EVIDENCE / "role-samples"
OBSERVED_FAILURE_ROUTE = BASE / "evidence/candidate-v3-20261005T224125Z-6ab847de/probe-route/evidence"


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def hashes() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {path: sha(ROOT / path) for path in MANIFEST["sha256"]}


def dump(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def json_sha_dir(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {str(p.relative_to(path)): sha(p) for p in sorted(path.rglob("*.json"))}


run = BASE / "evidence" / f"analyzer-v4-{datetime.now(timezone.utc):%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
run.mkdir(parents=True)
source_before = hashes()
zip_sha = sha(BASE / "candidate-v4/source.zip")
preflight = {
    "head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
    "candidate_zip_sha256": zip_sha,
    "expected_candidate_zip_sha256": EXPECTED_ZIP,
    "manifest_paths": len(MANIFEST["sha256"]),
    "expected_paths": MANIFEST["source_path_count"],
    "source_matches_candidate_v4": source_before == MANIFEST["sha256"],
    "mismatches": [path for path in source_before if source_before[path] != MANIFEST["sha256"][path]],
    "analyzer_sha256": sha(ANALYZER),
    "expected_analyzer_sha256": MANIFEST["sha256"]["work/ceres-v3/05/analyze-evidence.py"],
}
dump(run / "freeze-check.json", preflight)
if (zip_sha != EXPECTED_ZIP or len(source_before) != 306 or not preflight["source_matches_candidate_v4"]
        or preflight["head"] != MANIFEST["git_head"]):
    print(json.dumps({"run": str(run), "preflight": preflight}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(2)

raw_input_hashes = {
    "route_results": sha(RAW_ROUTES / "results.json"),
    "route_raw_json": json_sha_dir(RAW_ROUTES),
    "role_raw_json": json_sha_dir(RAW_ROLES),
    "observer_route_results": sha(OBSERVED_FAILURE_ROUTE / "results.json"),
}
dump(run / "raw-inputs.json", {
    "original_v3_routes": str(RAW_ROUTES), "original_v3_roles": str(RAW_ROLES),
    "observer_failure_route": str(OBSERVED_FAILURE_ROUTE), "sha256": raw_input_hashes,
    "role_ids_and_status": {p.stem: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("passed")
                             for p in sorted(RAW_ROLES.glob("*.json"))},
})

# Construct disposable, explicitly synthetic analyzer inputs; never edit raw evidence.
scenario_root = run / "fixtures"
scenario_root.mkdir()
role_files = {p.stem: p for p in RAW_ROLES.glob("*.json")}
successful_role = next((p for p in sorted(role_files.values())
                        if json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("passed")), None)
if successful_role is None:
    raise SystemExit("no successful original role receipt is available for partial-input fixture")


def copy_json_inputs(name: str, routes: Path, roles: list[Path]) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    folder = scenario_root / name
    route_copy, role_copy = folder / "routes", folder / "roles"
    route_copy.mkdir(parents=True)
    role_copy.mkdir()
    shutil.copyfile(routes / "results.json", route_copy / "results.json")
    for file in roles:
        shutil.copyfile(file, role_copy / file.name)
    return route_copy, role_copy


one_routes, one_roles = copy_json_inputs("one-successful-role", RAW_ROUTES, [successful_role])
one_role = json.loads((one_roles / successful_role.name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
dump(one_routes.parent / "fixture-note.json", {
    "scenario": "only one successful role receipt",
    "chosen_case": one_role["case_id"],
    "source_receipt_sha256": sha(successful_role),
    "not_business_evidence": True,
})

missing_routes, missing_roles = copy_json_inputs("five-roles-h01-handoff-omitted", RAW_ROUTES, [])
for case_id in ("R01", "R01-named-product-variant", "R02", "R03", "H01"):
    receipt = {"case_id": case_id, "passed": True, "backend_api_wall_ms": 100.0, "upstream": []}
    if case_id == "H01":
        receipt["handoff_backend_wall_ms"] = 250.0
    dump(missing_roles / f"{case_id}.json", receipt)
h01 = json.loads((missing_roles / "H01.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
h01.pop("handoff_backend_wall_ms")
dump(missing_roles / "H01.json", h01)
dump(missing_routes.parent / "fixture-note.json", {
    "scenario": "synthetic five-role set, all other gates satisfied, H01 handoff_backend_wall_ms omitted",
    "role_values_are_synthetic": True,
    "not_business_or_model_evidence": True,
})

observer_routes, observer_roles = copy_json_inputs(
    "observer-route-request-failed", OBSERVED_FAILURE_ROUTE,
    [p for p in sorted(RAW_ROLES.glob("*.json"))],
)
dump(observer_routes.parent / "fixture-note.json", {
    "scenario": "actual public TestClient.send observer failure; requested_rows=22 and only captured first row",
    "route_source_sha256": sha(OBSERVED_FAILURE_ROUTE / "results.json"),
    "not_full_performance_evidence": True,
})

empty_routes, empty_roles = copy_json_inputs("empty-role-samples", RAW_ROUTES, [])
dump(empty_routes.parent / "fixture-note.json", {
    "scenario": "no role receipts; checks analyzer reports None/missing rather than throwing",
    "not_business_or_model_evidence": True,
})

scenarios = [
    ("original-v3-22-routes-5-roles", RAW_ROUTES, sorted(RAW_ROLES.glob("*.json")), "original"),
    ("negative-one-successful-role", one_routes, sorted(one_roles.glob("*.json")), "one_role"),
    ("negative-h01-handoff-omitted", missing_routes, sorted(missing_roles.glob("*.json")), "handoff"),
    ("negative-observer-route-partial", observer_routes, sorted(observer_roles.glob("*.json")), "route"),
    ("negative-empty-role-directory", empty_routes, sorted(empty_roles.glob("*.json")), "empty"),
]

system_vars = {key: os.environ[key] for key in ("PATH", "SYSTEMROOT", "WINDIR") if key in os.environ}
records = {}
for name, routes, roles, kind in scenarios:
    folder = run / name
    folder.mkdir()
    temp = folder / "temp"
    temp.mkdir()
    env = system_vars | {"TEMP": str(temp), "TMP": str(temp), "PYTHONUTF8": "1", "PYTHONNOUSERSITE": "1"}
    outpath = folder / "analysis.json"
    argv = [str(PYTHON), "-X", "utf8", str(ANALYZER), "--routes", str(routes),
            "--role-samples", str(roles[0].parent if roles else (folder / "empty-roles")),
            "--output", str(outpath)]
    if not roles:
        (folder / "empty-roles").mkdir()
    dump(folder / "command.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(ROOT), "shell": False})
    (folder / "command.txt").write_text(subprocess.list2cmdline(argv) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    dump(folder / "environment.json", {
        "explicit_environment": {k: v for k, v in env.items() if k != "PATH"},
        "PATH": "inherited for Windows/Python runtime; value intentionally not copied",
        "no_dotenv_or_credentials_loaded": True,
    })
    source_pre = hashes()
    input_manifest = {"routes": json_sha_dir(routes), "roles": json_sha_dir(roles[0].parent) if roles else {}}
    dump(folder / "input-sha256.json", input_manifest)
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (folder / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (folder / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False)
    duration = time.monotonic() - started
    source_post = hashes()
    output = json.loads(outpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if outpath.exists() else None
    result_row = {
        "exit_code": result.returncode, "duration_seconds": duration,
        "stdout_sha256": sha(folder / "stdout.txt"), "stderr_sha256": sha(folder / "stderr.txt"),
        "output_sha256": sha(outpath) if outpath.exists() else None,
        "source_unchanged": source_pre == source_post == source_before,
        "source_before_sha256": source_pre, "source_after_sha256": source_post,
        "metrics": None if output is None else {key: output.get(key) for key in (
            "route_n", "route_correct", "route_failed", "route_p95_ms", "route_timing_missing_n",
            "route_q20_pass", "role_sample_n", "role_missing_cases", "reply_observations_n",
            "reply_max_ms", "reply_q20_pass")},
    }
    dump(folder / "result.json", result_row)
    records[name] = result_row
    print(json.dumps({"scenario": name, "exit": result.returncode, "metrics": result_row["metrics"]}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)

checks = {}
orig = records["original-v3-22-routes-5-roles"]["metrics"]
one = records["negative-one-successful-role"]["metrics"]
handoff = records["negative-h01-handoff-omitted"]["metrics"]
route = records["negative-observer-route-partial"]["metrics"]
empty = records["negative-empty-role-directory"]["metrics"]
checks["one_successful_role_rejected_and_cases_named_missing"] = bool(
    one and one["role_sample_n"] == 1 and one["reply_q20_pass"] is False
    and len(one["role_missing_cases"]) == 4)
checks["missing_h01_handoff_rejected_by_six_observation_gate"] = bool(
    handoff and handoff["role_sample_n"] == 5 and handoff["reply_observations_n"] == 5
    and handoff["reply_q20_pass"] is False)
checks["observer_route_missing_timing_rejected_without_zero_fill"] = bool(
    route and route["route_n"] == 1 and route["route_timing_missing_n"] == 1
    and route["route_p95_ms"] is None and route["route_q20_pass"] is False)
checks["empty_role_input_returns_none_and_missing_ids"] = bool(
    empty and empty["role_sample_n"] == 0 and empty["reply_max_ms"] is None
    and len(empty["role_missing_cases"]) == 5 and empty["reply_q20_pass"] is False)
checks["original_v3_r01_failure_preserved_in_analysis"] = bool(
    orig and orig["route_n"] == 22 and orig["role_sample_n"] == 5
    and orig["reply_q20_pass"] is False
    and any(x["case_id"] == "R01" and not x["passed"]
            for x in json.loads((run / "original-v3-22-routes-5-roles/analysis.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["role_samples"]))
dump(run / "validation-checks.json", checks)
final_source = hashes()
dump(run / "run-summary.json", {
    "candidate_zip_sha256": zip_sha, "source_paths": len(final_source),
    "source_stable": final_source == source_before == MANIFEST["sha256"],
    "scenarios": records, "checks": checks,
})
print(json.dumps({"run": str(run), "source_stable": final_source == source_before,
                  "checks": checks, "original_v3_metrics": orig}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
